name: Owner
description: The issue owner of the ticket

name: Retrigger on done
description: Set by the squad leader on a sub-task it re-triggers for fix work (re-armed Build/Scenarios, or a Fix sub-task filed at or above a blocked gate). Value: the key of each blocked issue to flip in_progress and re-trigger once this one is done, comma-separated when there are several (MXW-1703,MXW-1704). Leader drops each key once that issue is re-armed and clears the property when none is left.
